text:
clare: Quick internal GA announcement: hosted endpoint "fast-edge" is now GA in eu-west-1 and us-west-2. Fast-edge is tuned for single-digit p95 token latency for short-seq interactive apps. It includes streaming + function/tool-calling and a new adaptive-kv cache layer. Docs & latency profiles: https://internal.redwood.dev/hosted/fast-edge-ga

deploy-bot: rollout note: fast-edge canary -> eu-west-1 ok, 0.3% error rate increase but within expected if you include socket transient drops. :white_check_mark:

noah: Is aliasing changing? what happens to existing "edge" alias?

clare: Alias plan: we will create "edge-fast" and offer a 7-day opt-in. The "edge" alias remains unchanged for now; automatic flip is scheduled only after metrics stabilize.

rebecca: Heads-up for sales: fast-edge SKU will be a new premium tier. I'm drafting pricing language and the sales one-pager. Please embargo public marketing until next week.

ops-oncall: Ops changes: default connection cap per instance increased 30->60; also increased KV cache TTL defaults for fast-edge to improve hit rates. New observability dashboards: /dashboards/fast-edge-p95 and /dashboards/fast-edge-kv-hitrate. Paging rule: p95 > 200ms sustained 5m triggers page.

infra: Noted the transient socket drops during canary. We'll roll a kernel tuning patch to improve backlog handling. Patch ETA 18h.

noah: Dedicated/private compatibility?

ops-oncall: Dedicated clusters need runtime v1.15+ to get adaptive-kv and tool-calls. We'll publish a safemode flag --kv-adaptive=false for clusters that need to opt out during upgrade.

clare: Sample curl for streaming + tool-calls (for support KB):
```bash
curl -N -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/stream" \ 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \ 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ 
  -d '{"model":"fast-edge","stream":true,"tool_calls":true,"input":"Translate and call tools"}'
```

sales: Please send the early access customer list to me. We'll coordinate pricing and outreach.

devtools-bot: PR #708 merged; SDK helper for adaptive-kv added.

rebecca: Town hall tomorrow 10:00 PT to walk through pricing and rollout comms. Recording + slides will be attached in the doc.

clare: Thanks team. Watch the dashboards over the next 48h and escalate anything weird. :rocket:
